lines.text: I that please some, try all: both joy and terror
lines.plainText: I that please some try all both joy and terror

lines.text: Of good and bad, that makes and unfolds error,
lines.plainText: Of good and bad that makes and unfolds error

lines.text: Now take upon me, in the name of Time,
lines.plainText: Now take upon me in the name of Time

lines.text: To use my wings. Impute it not a crime
lines.plainText: To use my wings Impute it not a crime

lines.text: To me or my swift passage, that I slide
lines.plainText: To me or my swift passage that I slide

lines.text: O'er sixteen years, and leave the growth untried
lines.plainText: O'er sixteen years and leave the growth untried

lines.text: Of that wide gap, since it is in my power
lines.plainText: Of that wide gap since it is in my power

lines.text: To o'erthrow law, and in one self-born hour
lines.plainText: To o'erthrow law and in one selfborn hour

lines.text: To plant and o'erwhelm custom. Let me pass
lines.plainText: To plant and o'erwhelm custom Let me pass

lines.text: The same I am, ere ancient'st order was
lines.plainText: The same I am ere ancient'st order was

lines.text: Or what is now received. I witness to
lines.plainText: Or what is now received I witness to

lines.text: The times that brought them in; so shall I do
lines.plainText: The times that brought them in so shall I do

lines.text: To th' freshest things now reigning, and make stale
lines.plainText: To th' freshest things now reigning and make stale

lines.text: The glistering of this present, as my tale
lines.plainText: The glistering of this present as my tale

lines.text: Now seems to it. Your patience this allowing,
lines.plainText: Now seems to it Your patience this allowing

lines.text: I turn my glass, and give my scene such growing
lines.plainText: I turn my glass and give my scene such growing

lines.text: As you had slept between. Leontes leaving
lines.plainText: As you had slept between Leontes leaving

lines.text: Th' effects of his fond jealousies, so grieving
lines.plainText: Th' effects of his fond jealousies so grieving

lines.text: That he shuts up himself, imagine me,
lines.plainText: That he shuts up himself imagine me

lines.text: Gentle spectators, that I now may be
lines.plainText: Gentle spectators that I now may be

lines.text: In fair Bohemia, and remember well,
lines.plainText: In fair Bohemia and remember well

lines.text: I mentioned a son o' th' king's, which Florizel
lines.plainText: I mentioned a son o' th' king's which Florizel

lines.text: I now name to you; and with speed so pace
lines.plainText: I now name to you and with speed so pace

lines.text: To speak of Perdita, now grown in grace
lines.plainText: To speak of Perdita now grown in grace

lines.text: Equal with wondering. What of her ensues
lines.plainText: Equal with wondering What of her ensues

lines.text: I list not prophesy; but let Time's news
lines.plainText: I list not prophesy but let Time's news

lines.text: Be known when 'tis brought forth. A shepherd's daughter,
lines.plainText: Be known when 'tis brought forth A shepherd's daughter

lines.text: And what to her adheres, which follows after,
lines.plainText: And what to her adheres which follows after

lines.text: Is th' argument of Time. Of this allow,
lines.plainText: Is th' argument of Time Of this allow

lines.text: If ever you have spent time worse ere now;
lines.plainText: If ever you have spent time worse ere now

lines.text: If never, yet that Time himself doth say
lines.plainText: If never yet that Time himself doth say

lines.text: He wishes earnestly you never may.
lines.plainText: He wishes earnestly you never may
